worn_oathblade.name: Worn Oathblade
worn_oathblade.description: Swings itself at whatever is nearest, in a wide arc.
worn_oathblade.lore: Every Watch recruit swore on a blade like this. Most of the oaths outlasted the recruits.

judgement_disc_item.name: Watch Buckler
judgement_disc_item.description: A thrown shield that ricochets between foes.

butchers_cleaver.name: Butcher's Cleaver
butchers_cleaver.description: A wide, heavy chop in front of you that opens wounds.

gyre_axes.name: Pair of Gyre Axes
gyre_axes.description: Axes that circle you, shredding whatever closes in.

apprentice_wand.name: Apprentice's Wand
apprentice_wand.description: Looses seeking motes that find their own way.

ember_staff.name: Ember Staff
ember_staff.description: Hurls slow cinders that burst and set things burning.

rime_rod.name: Rime Rod
rime_rod.description: Piercing shards of cold that chill and, in time, freeze.

hunting_bow.name: Hunter's Crossbow
hunting_bow.description: Looses a spread of bolts at the nearest foe.

knife_belt.name: Knife Belt
knife_belt.description: Throws a ring of knives in every direction.

storm_totem.name: Storm-Carved Totem
storm_totem.description: Calls lightning that leaps between foes.
storm_totem.lore: The Karrash carve these from lightning-struck oak. This one still hums.

censer_of_dawn.name: Censer of Dawn
censer_of_dawn.description: Pulses searing Light outward from you. The dead hate it.

moonbrand_charm.name: Moonbrand Charm
moonbrand_charm.description: Moonlit flame that tracks its prey and marks it.

thornseed_pouch.name: Thornseed Pouch
thornseed_pouch.description: Brambles burst up under the nearest crowd.

grave_tether_wand.name: Grave Tether
grave_tether_wand.description: Coils of dark that wound the living and knit your own flesh.
grave_tether_wand.downside: The Order of Morning Light does not approve.

old_hunters_cloak.name: Old Hunter's Cloak
old_hunters_cloak.description: 25% less from beasts. 10% faster while beasts are near.
old_hunters_cloak.downside: 15% more damage from fire: old wool, older grease.
old_hunters_cloak.lore: It smells of pine, smoke and wolf. The wolves notice.

wolf_fang_necklace.name: Wolf-Fang Necklace
wolf_fang_necklace.description: Hits have a 12% chance to bleed. +30% critical chance against the bleeding.
wolf_fang_necklace.lore: A wolf does not give up a fang. A wolf that sees you wearing one will want to know how you came by it.

ashen_plate.name: Ashen Plate
ashen_plate.description: +8 armour. 40% fire resistance. +20% fire damage. Standing in fire grants 8 more armour.
ashen_plate.downside: 8% slower. It weighs what it weighs.
ashen_plate.lore: Forged in a burning house by a smith who would not leave it.

red_kerchief.name: Red Kerchief
red_kerchief.description: Kerchiefs take you for one of their own - until you draw on them.
red_kerchief.downside: The Watch takes you for one of them, too.
red_kerchief.lore: Red cloth over the face. The rest of the uniform is attitude.

blightward_mask.name: Blightward Mask
blightward_mask.description: Breathe blighted air unharmed. 50% nature resistance.
blightward_mask.lore: Wenna stuffs the beak with bitterroot and something she will not name.

pilgrims_lantern.name: Pilgrim's Ember-Lantern
pilgrims_lantern.description: Your light reaches 40% farther. The dead take 15% more from you.
pilgrims_lantern.lore: Lit from the last lamp in the Chapel of the Morning Light. It has never gone out.

cracked_lens.name: Cracked Lens
cracked_lens.description: +5% critical chance. Old script becomes legible through it.
cracked_lens.lore: Ground in the Low Cloister for reading palimpsests. The crack is newer.

lockpicks.name: Lockpicks
lockpicks.description: Opens simple locks. Carried, not worn.

moonsilver_circlet.name: Moonsilver Circlet
moonsilver_circlet.description: +15% damage at night. Critical strikes at night call a shaft of moonlight.
moonsilver_circlet.lore: It was in the grove, under the brambles, where the wolves go when one of them is dying.

grimtunnels_lamp.name: Grimtunnel's Spare Lamp
grimtunnels_lamp.description: +25% fire damage. Lamplings hesitate before they strike you.
grimtunnels_lamp.lore: He dropped it going down the hole at the Low Ford. It is still warm, and it is still his, and he will want it back. Scratched round the rim, small, in lampling letters, over and over: DOWNSTAIRS. DOWNSTAIRS. DOWNSTAIRS.

wardens_lampiron.name: The Warden's Lamp-Iron
wardens_lampiron.description: +20% damage to the dead. Killing one has a 12% chance to loose a pale flame that strikes the next.
wardens_lampiron.lore: The iron cage of the lamp the Ford-Warden carried. Under the socket, cut clean and new, a smith's mark: a ring with a hammer across it. It was made to hold ember, not oil. Whatever burned in it went down a hole in Grimtunnel's arms. The cage still remembers the light.

bone_charm.name: Barrow-Bone Charm
bone_charm.description: +20% damage to the dead. Kills have a 3% chance to raise a servant for 10 s.
bone_charm.downside: Chid will know what it is.

wolfhide_cloak.name: Wolfhide Cloak
wolfhide_cloak.description: +20 maximum health. +8% speed. 15% less damage from beasts.
wolfhide_cloak.downside: Any wolf can smell what it is made of.
wolfhide_cloak.lore: Brannoc stitched it from five pelts. He did not ask where they came from; he did not need to.

leather_cap.name: Leather Cap
leather_cap.description: A cap. It keeps rain off.

iron_helm.name: Iron Helm
iron_helm.description: Dented, but it was dented protecting someone.

wolf_pelt.name: Wolf Pelt
wolf_pelt.description: Thick grey fur. Brannoc pays for these; Holloway counts them.

bitterroot.name: Bitterroot
bitterroot.description: Grows where the water is bad. Wenna wants it.

moonpetal.name: Moonpetal
moonpetal.description: Opens only at night, only where the ground is clean.

ember_shard.name: Ember Shard
ember_shard.description: A stone that kept some of its light. It does not keep forever. Hold it to your ear in a quiet room, and the room is not quite quiet.

kerchief_cloth.name: Red Cloth
kerchief_cloth.description: Cut from a Kerchief. Proof, of a sort.

bandages.name: Clean Bandages
bandages.description: Treats a wound: an injury heals a day sooner.

greymuzzle_fang.name: Greymuzzle's Fang
greymuzzle_fang.description: The old wolf's fang. Holloway would pay for it. Maeca would not want to see it.

stream_sample.name: Stream Sample
stream_sample.description: A stoppered bottle of green water from the Thornhollow stream.

slurry_sample.name: Ember Slurry
slurry_sample.description: Warm, faintly glowing sludge scraped from a pipe. It smells like a chapel lamp, and a little like a wound.

caravan_manifest.name: Torn Manifest
caravan_manifest.description: A Coyle Company manifest: salt, cloth, iron... and six crates marked only "B.E.", for a buyer named G.

coyle_strongbox.name: Coyle Strongbox
coyle_strongbox.description: Heavy, locked, stamped with the Coyle Company seal. There is a Coyle Trading Post in the Waystation.
coyle_strongbox.lore: Someone has tried the lock with a knife, and given up, and tried again.

pell_ledger.name: Pell's Ledger
pell_ledger.description: Pell Varrow's own book. Two payments on one night: forty to "R.", and ten to Jessop, "for the road".
pell_ledger.lore: Small, tidy figures. In the margin of the last page, in the same hand: "tell Holloway where they camp, after."

clerks_key.name: Toll Clerk's Key
clerks_key.description: A key to Pell Varrow's warehouse, which Jessop the toll clerk should not have had.

sigil_fragment.name: Sigil Fragment
sigil_fragment.description: Black stone, cut in a shape that fits the sealed door. It hums against your teeth.
sigil_fragment.lore: Found in the hand of someone who did not make it out.

map_fragment.name: Digger's Map
map_fragment.description: A lampling survey of the tunnels under the Verge. The last tunnel just says "DOWN" and keeps going.

blasting_ember.name: Blasting Ember
blasting_ember.description: A crate-charge of unstable ember. Something could be blown open with this. Or up. It is warm, and warmer when you are afraid.

manual_sprint.name: Manual: Sprint
manual_sprint.description: Read it to learn Sprint, an art to carry. Read again, it comes more easily.
manual_sprint.lore: A courier's book of the road, all of it about getting away. The margins are full of routes that end at a door.

manual_leap.name: Manual: Crashing Leap
manual_leap.description: Read it to learn Crashing Leap, an art to carry. Read again, it comes more easily.
manual_leap.lore: A reaver's primer, nearly all pictures. The pictures are of people landing on other people.

manual_blink.name: Manual: Blink
manual_blink.description: Read it to learn Blink, an art to carry. Read again, it comes more easily.
manual_blink.lore: A folded page of the Collegium's, the one they tell apprentices not to read. The ink moves when you do not look at it.

manual_mirror_step.name: Manual: Mirror Step
manual_mirror_step.description: Read it to learn Mirror Step, an art to carry. Read again, it comes more easily.
manual_mirror_step.lore: Glass-sworn doctrine: that a thing seen twice is a thing that cannot be hit. The last page is a mirror, cracked.

manual_bull_rush.name: Manual: Bull Rush
manual_bull_rush.description: Read it to learn Bull Rush, an art to carry. Read again, it comes more easily.
manual_bull_rush.lore: A Watch drill-book on breaking a line. Someone has underlined 'do not stop' three times.

manual_wraith_walk.name: Manual: Wraith Walk
manual_wraith_walk.description: Read it to learn Wraith Walk, an art to carry. Read again, it comes more easily.
manual_wraith_walk.lore: Written by someone who died partway through writing it, and finished it anyway.

manual_cinder_trail.name: Manual: Cinder Trail
manual_cinder_trail.description: Read it to learn Cinder Trail, an art to carry. Read again, it comes more easily.
manual_cinder_trail.lore: The pages are scorched from the back. Whoever wrote it ran while they wrote it.

manual_grapple.name: Manual: Grapple Chain
manual_grapple.description: Read it to learn Grapple Chain, an art to carry. Read again, it comes more easily.
manual_grapple.lore: A ravine-raider's notes on chain and hook, with a length of the chain still sewn into the spine.

manual_echo_step.name: Manual: Echo Step
manual_echo_step.description: Read it to learn Echo Step, an art to carry. Read again, it comes more easily.
manual_echo_step.lore: A treatise on the moment just gone. It reads the same forward and back, and it says so.

manual_vault.name: Manual: Vault
manual_vault.description: Read it to learn Vault, an art to carry. Read again, it comes more easily.
manual_vault.lore: A stalker's hand-sewn book of snares and the art of not being there when they close.
